record.name: Maldives
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A National AI Masterplan covering risk management and a legal framework was announced in October 2024 and appears still to be in draft, and no evaluation body is named.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.
Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying national institute was found. The Presidency's primary masterplan announcement assigns ministries responsibility for AI planning, risk management and legal frameworks; it does not identify a technical body to evaluate advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The President's Office describes the AI masterplan, risk management and planned legal framework with responsible ministries; subsequent adoption was not verified.

related_bodies.name: Maldives Digital Service
related_bodies.role: It was established on 15 January 2026, when the National Centre for Information Technology (NCIT) was abolished, and was to assume all of NCIT's responsibilities; NCIT had worked with the steering committee that compiled the UNESCO readiness assessment launched on 31 July 2025.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Homeland Security and Technology
related_bodies.role: It is responsible, with the economic development ministry, for presenting the masterplan to Cabinet.

record.notes: The President's Office announcement (17 October 2024) says the masterplan covers 'risk management in utilising AI' and a legal framework. An aggregator reports the masterplan as still a draft, with a planned independent AI governance body; this was not confirmed against an official text. Searches in English found no adopted plan; Dhivehi sources were not found.

next_check.reason: Cabinet approval of the masterplan and whether it creates an AI governance or testing body.
